timestamp_note: date is observed and required baseline; format/timezone/precision must be verified. date_nanos is a separate version-specific laboratory question; @timestamp is not an automatic substitute.
multifield_note: Exact .keyword paths must exist and be compatible. A keyword at the unsuffixed parent does not supply .keyword. No analyzed-text parent requirement is inferred. Adding multifields would not backfill indexed history and is outside scope.
